changeSet.author: kmcnamee
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'LoadItemColumn') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[LoadItemColumn]( [LoadID] [int] NOT NULL, [RowIndex] [int] NOT NULL, [ColumnIndex] [int] NOT NULL, [Value] [nvarchar](max) NULL, [LookupObject] [varchar](50) NULL, [LookupObjectID] [int] NULL, [LookupValue] [nvarchar](2000) NULL, [Success] [bit] NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_LoadItemColumn] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [LoadID] ASC, [RowIndex] ASC, [ColumnIndex] ASC ) ) END
-- drop the index so we can alter the lookupvalue length IF EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_LoadItemColumn_Load_ColumnIndex_Value') BEGIN DROP INDEX [IX_LoadItemColumn_Load_ColumnIndex_Value] ON [dbo].[LoadItemColumn] END
ALTER TABLE [dbo].[LoadItemColumn] ALTER COLUMN [LookupValue] nvarchar(400) null;
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_LoadItemColumn_LoadColumn') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[LoadItemColumn] WITH NOCHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_LoadItemColumn_LoadColumn] FOREIGN KEY([LoadID], [ColumnIndex]) REFERENCES [dbo].[LoadColumn] ([LoadID], [ColumnIndex]) ALTER TABLE [dbo].[LoadItemColumn] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_LoadItemColumn_LoadColumn] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_LoadItemColumn_LoadItem') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[LoadItemColumn] WITH NOCHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_LoadItemColumn_LoadItem] FOREIGN KEY([LoadID], [RowIndex]) REFERENCES [dbo].[LoadItem] ([LoadID], [RowIndex]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [dbo].[LoadItemColumn] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_LoadItemColumn_LoadItem] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_LoadItemColumn_Load') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_LoadItemColumn_Load] ON [dbo].[LoadItemColumn] ( [LoadID] DESC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_LoadItemColumn_Load_ColumnIndex') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_LoadItemColumn_Load_ColumnIndex] ON [dbo].[LoadItemColumn] ( [LoadID] DESC, [ColumnIndex] ASC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_LoadItemColumn_Load_ColumnIndex_LookupObjectID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_LoadItemColumn_Load_ColumnIndex_LookupObjectID] ON [dbo].[LoadItemColumn] ( [LoadID] DESC, [ColumnIndex] ASC, [LookupObjectID] ASC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_LoadItemColumn_Load_ColumnIndex_Value') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_LoadItemColumn_Load_ColumnIndex_Value] ON [dbo].[LoadItemColumn] ( [LoadID] DESC, [ColumnIndex] ASC, [LookupValue] ASC ) END
